Q: File path not being returned on listing of files in my local server but is returned on live site A:

Your code isn't causing the difference. Its just parsing the HTML returned by the server.

Different web servers or even different directory listing configurations on the same server can generate different href values. One may return just file.txt, while another returns /folder/file.txt or a full path. All of those are valid.

So yes this is controlled by the servers directory listing not by DOMParser or your JavaScript.

Q: GCP Agent Platform pipelines ModelGetOp issue A:

I have found an workable solution.

GetModelOp does not seem to work as documented. I used GetVertexModelOp instead and it loaded the model into the pipeline correctly.

The code below worked:

@kfp.dsl.pipeline(
    name=DISPLAY_NAME,
    pipeline_root=BUCKET_URI,
    
    )
def pipeline(PROJECT_ID: str):

    model_task = GetVertexModelOp(
        model_name='projects/80514224188/locations/us-central1/models/1800006515679555824',
    )
    endpoint_op = EndpointCreateOp(
        project=PROJECT_ID,
        location=GCP_REGION,
        display_name=DISPLAY_NAME,
    )

    ModelDeployOp(
        model=model_task.outputs["model"],
        endpoint=endpoint_op.outputs["endpoint"],
        dedicated_resources_min_replica_count=1,
        dedicated_resources_max_replica_count=1,
        dedicated_resources_machine_type=MACHINE_TYPE,
    )

Q: How can I transfer a file with special character to my Android SDcard? A:

I had the very same problem as you, I got a file from summer holidays which had in the title a little "sun" special character, and couldn't copy it to my new smartphone.

I backed up everything from my old phone to my PC, and then wanted to copy back to my new one, but those files with special characters blocked the copy.

I searched the internet for a whole day, but clearly couldn't find any valid answer that could do it simply.

And then I got a genius Idea, that only works for those with "SD Card", not the phone itself, that's why I recommend a phone with a SD Card slot btw.

  1. Put the SD Card in the phone to make it compatible, and when it's inserted for the first time, it will erase everything on it.

  2. take out the SD Card and insert it in a USB Stick that has an SD Card slot, and put it on your PC

  3. You see where it's going, right? Copy the files and Put the SD Card back in the phone, et voilà!

  4. Enjoy

Btw, such an USB Stick is extremely cheap, and it saves you so much time, because it's far more faster since you copy the files on your PC

Q: I get stuck learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (I am a student) A:

You can take something you want to learn, say building a contact form, and just build it, learning as you go. Between physically building it, and watching tutorials, I’ve found helps my learning curve.

Once complete, you can break it in various ways to see how the browser handles it, and what happens when certain features fail. Can help with troubleshooting down the road also.

Also many free learning resources like Cisco Networking Acedemy to gain solid knowledge in specific areas of tech.
